preconditions.expression: root1 is not None and root2 is not None

preconditions.description: Both trees have the same number of nodes, and each node has an integer value between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 1 if all(sorted(level1) == sorted(level2) for level1, level2 in zip(levels(root1), levels(root2))) else 0
postconditions.description: Returns 1 if and only if for every corresponding level in the two trees, the multiset of node values at that level in the first tree is identical to the multiset of node values at that level in the second tree; otherwise returns 0.
